postings.conferenceText: International Conference on Buddhonomics 2026 Theme: Partnering for Prosperity, Posterity, and Peace 20–22 November 2026 | IIM Bodh Gaya, Bihar, India Pre-Conference Workshop: 19 November 2026 The conference invites researchers, academicians, practitioners, and policymakers to submit original research addressing the principles and applications of Buddhonomics and their relevance to contemporary economic and managerial challenges. The conference welcomes research on sustainable and mindful development, peace and harmony, ethical governance, responsible innovation, moral institutions, cultural and spiritual dimensions of economics, and contemporary issues in economics and management. Abstract Submission Deadline: 30 September 2026 Acceptance Notification: By 5 October 2026 For submission guidelines and further details, please visit the conference website. *Deadline Extended: Call for Abstracts – International Conference on Buddhonomics 2026* 🏛️ *IIM Bodh Gaya, Bihar* | 📅 *20–22 November 2026* *Pre-conference workshop:* *19 November 2026* The conference, organized by *IIM Bodh Gaya* in collaboration with *Nalanda University* and the *University of Colombo*, seeks to integrate Buddhist wisdom with contemporary perspectives in economics, management, governance, and development under the theme: ✨ *“Partnering for Prosperity, Posterity, and Peace.”* ✨ *Submission tracks:* 1. Buddhonomics – Reimagining the Global Economic Order 2. Sustainable and Mindful Development 3. Peace, Prosperity, and Geopolitical Harmony 4. Human Capital, Governance, and Moral Institutions 5. Business, Mindfulness, and Responsible Innovation 6. Cultural, Historical, and Spiritual Dimensions 7. General Management and Economics — Contemporary Perspectives *Best Paper Award:* Cash prizes worth ₹45,000 + fast-tracked publication opportunities and engagement with scholars, policymakers, and industry leaders. 📚 *Submit here:* https://tinyurl.com/5eefsfmm ⏳ *Abstract submission deadline:* 30th September, 2026 📩 *Acceptance notifications:* Latest by 5th October 📧 *Contact:* [email protected] Faculty, research scholars, and postgraduate students working in management, economics, public policy, governance, or mindfulness-related areas are encouraged to consider submission. remove *
